pros: Securely stores a wide variety of credential types beyond just passwords.
Seamlessly integrates with browsers and works across multiple devices.
Excellent value, especially considering the robust free tier for core features.
cons: User interface can feel less polished compared to some competitors.
Organizational features for sharing and team management can be less intuitive to set up.
Occasional minor issues with browser extension syncing or re-login requirements.
changed: Pro 1: Replaced 'Securely stores passwords and sensitive development credentials like API keys' with 'Securely stores a wide variety of credential types beyond just passwords' because the note '[benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown' highlights the breadth of item types supported.

Con 2: Replaced 'May require some effort for initial organization of existing credentials' with 'Organizational features for sharing and team management can be less intuitive to set up' because the notes '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization...' and '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console...' point to specific friction in setting up shared organizational structures, which is a more specific and persistent concern than initial personal credential organization.
